questions.prompt: Completing the square on ax² + bx + c = 0 (a ≠ 0) gives (x + b ÷ (2a))² = (b² - 4ac) ÷ (4a²), which leads to the quadratic formula.
questions.prompt_markup: Completing the square on ax² + bx + c = 0 (a ≠ 0) gives (x + b ÷ (2a))² = (b² - 4ac) ÷ (4a²), which leads to the quadratic formula.
questions.grading_note: Divide by a, move c ÷ a, and add (b ÷ (2a))² to both sides. Taking square roots gives x = (-b ± √(b² - 4ac)) ÷ (2a).
